dependency_text: Accepted source studies, with their stated populations and limits.
objective: Determine which ordinary and bond readings of two, three or four original same-side marks distinguish a once-loaded ring, at what source offset, layer, reading radius and dose, alone or with a second ring.
status: Original marks on one side detect a once-loaded ring before reaching an original ring knot. An ordinary count loses exactly two at arbitrarily large offsets with growing radius. Both fixed ordinary and fixed bond radii have all-age protection on the singly attached paths. The old far pair stays at bond distance nine and counts 45/46 knots at bond radius seven.
stop_rule: Give a certified same-side witness or a range theorem for the stated reading, compare all five readings, distinguish fixed-radius and unrestricted views and publish any remaining bounds and unresolved all-age cases.
title: Can old marks wholly on one side read a distant loaded ring?
